name: Movement Active

intent_defaults.description: A movement-oriented design direction that gives priority to articulation, mobility and user-selected compression or ease.
intent_defaults.silhouette: User-defined close, regular or relaxed fit based on the activity.

component_defaults.articulation: Knee, elbow and hip articulation where relevant
component_defaults.seams: Seam placement selected for comfort and movement

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: This is not certified sports, medical or protective equipment.
Compression, support, moisture transfer and performance claims require defined tests and user evaluation.
